_comment: EXAMPLE seat registry. Copy to ~/.sovereign/hq/seats/registry.json to seat
terminals on this machine. Nothing in the bridge writes this file: it is
Anthony's, by hand, and its absence is the off switch for seat identity.
A seat entry is a statement that Anthony put that terminal on the Studio.
'enabled' must be literally true; anything else denies. Deleting a seat, or
the file, revokes immediately - the registry is read fresh on every request.
